notes: a security pass. A plugin routed through the browser bridge or the connector extension now asks before every session — its calls ride your login, so the confirmation no longer depends on what risk the manifest declared. Plugin request paths are checked: an argument can no longer carry the call to a different endpoint on that host. skill_write and skill_delete always ask, because a skill outlives the chat that wrote it. A link in an imported plugin manifest must be http(s). And 1.25.1's own version script was blocked by its Content-Security-Policy, which left the app reporting 0.0.0, serving untagged cached files and offering an update forever — fixed, with a check in the release script so it cannot happen quietly again
